title: StockLevelChanged, version 1 (payload)
description: The payload of StockLevelChanged v1 (producer inventory, topic inventory.events, key = tenant ID). It is the 'payload' property of an envelope that validates against envelope.v1.schema.json, whose aggregateId is the inventory item. One event states one committed movement of the item's balance: the movement, its deltas and the balance after it. The order is guaranteed per item in commit order, and itemVersion increases by one per movement (ADR-028 section 3). Contract: docs/events/INVENTORY_EVENTS.md. Additional properties are allowed so that optional properties added later in v1 never invalidate messages for existing consumers.

movementId.description: The movement's ID (GUID version 7, lowercase D format). It equals the envelope's eventId: one movement is one fact.

movementType.description: What the movement did. Open set: new values may appear within v1 and consumers must handle unknown values without treating them as any known value (see the contract). Known values: InitialStock, Adjustment, Reservation, ReservationRelease, ReservationExpiry, ReservationCommit.

adjustmentReason.description: The reason of an Adjustment movement; null for every other type. Open set when present. Known values: Receipt, Return, Damage, Loss, Correction, CycleCount.

productId.description: Catalog's product ID of the item, verified when the item was created (ADR-027).

variantId.description: Catalog's variant ID of the item: unique per tenant in Inventory.

sku.description: The SKU snapshot recorded when the item was created: informational, Catalog owns the SKU and the snapshot can be stale (ADR-026 section 11). 1 to 64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -.

onHandDelta.description: The change of on-hand stock: the initial stock, the adjustment, the negative committed quantity, or 0.

reservedDelta.description: The change of reserved stock: the reserved quantity, its negative on release, expiry or commit, or 0.

reserved.description: Reserved stock after the movement; never above onHand.

available.description: onHand minus reserved after the movement; never negative.

itemVersion.description: The item's version after the movement: 1 for the initial stock, then increased by exactly 1 per movement. A consumer can order an item's facts by it and ignore an older state.

reservationId.description: The reservation of a Reservation, ReservationRelease, ReservationExpiry or ReservationCommit movement; null otherwise. Lowercase GUID, D format.
